newsitem.title: FRANCE: Air France says freighters not hit by pilot shortage.
newsitem.headline: Air France says freighters not hit by pilot shortage.

text.p: Air France said its Boeing 747-200 freighters would not be affected by the cancellation of around 60 flights over the next four days due to a pilot shortage
"There will be no impact whatsover on freighter operations as the cancellations largely concern domestic flights and a few European ones, an Air France official told Reuters.

The official said a number of the airline's pilots had worked overtime during prolonged strike action by some of their colleagues last month and were now on mandatory rest leave resulting in a shortage of personnel.

Associated factors were the need to re-train ex-Air Inter pilots and the time taken for the signature of contracts by trainee pilots, which also affected staff availility levels, the official added. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
